positions.source_passage: Let me be very clear, no one has the right to do that. No one has my permission to do experimental treatments, medications and patent, trademark, or copyright it and give me fabricated bank accounts, prescriptions, maintain total control of my medical, my privacy, everything while acting as another company. This needs to end immediately.
positions.position_gist: The commenter objects generally to what they describe as non-consensual experimentation, control of their medical information and privacy, and generative AI use without consent; the objection is a grievance narrative rather than a substantive response to the risk framework question.

positions.source_passage: Redacting my information to do experiments. No thanks- generative. I opt out
positions.position_gist: The commenter states a blanket refusal to consent to generative AI use of their information ('I opt out'), without addressing any specific regulatory approach.
